## Modules

- [RpcLoadBalancer](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.md): Distributed RPC load balancer built on `:pg`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.Config](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.Config.md): Configuration defaults for `RpcLoadBalancer`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.md): GenServer responsible for joining the `:pg` group, monitoring membership
changes, and performing graceful connection draining on shutdown.

- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.AlgorithmCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.AlgorithmCache.md)
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.CounterCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.CounterCache.md): Shared atomic counters for slot-based round-robin and
per-node connection tracking across all load balancers.

- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.Drainer](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.Drainer.md): Tracks in-flight RPC calls and provides graceful connection draining.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.DrainerCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.DrainerCache.md): Shared atomic counter for tracking in-flight calls per load balancer.

- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.HashRingCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.HashRingCache.md): ETS-backed cache for the consistent hash ring built by
`RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.HashRing`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.IndexRegistry](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.IndexRegistry.md): Assigns unique integer indices to arbitrary keys for a given cache.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.LoadBalancerOptsCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.LoadBalancerOptsCache.md): Cache for parsed, immutable per-load-balancer options.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.NodeCpuCache](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.NodeCpuCache.md): Shared ETS cache for CPU metrics, keyed by node.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.Pg](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.Pg.md): Wrapper around `:pg` used by `RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.md): Behaviour for load balancer node selection.

- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.CallDirect](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.CallDirect.md): Selection algorithm that executes calls directly on the local node.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.HashRing](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.HashRing.md): Consistent hash ring node selection algorithm powered by `libring`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastConnections](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastConnections.md): Least connections node selection algorithm.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastCpu](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastCpu.md): Least CPU node selection algorithm.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastCpu.Poller](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.LeastCpu.Poller.md): GenServer that periodically samples local CPU via `:cpu_sup` and fetches
remote node CPU via `:erpc.multicall/5`, storing all results in
`NodeCpuCache`.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.PowerOfTwo](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.PowerOfTwo.md): Power of Two Choices node selection algorithm.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.Random](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.Random.md): Random node selection algorithm.

- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.RoundRobin](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.RoundRobin.md): Round robin node selection algorithm.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.WeightedRoundRobin](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.LoadBalancer.SelectionAlgorithm.WeightedRoundRobin.md): Weighted round robin node selection algorithm.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.Metrics](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.Metrics.md): `Telemetry.Metrics` definitions for `RpcLoadBalancer.call/5`,
`RpcLoadBalancer.cast/5`, and node-selection events.
- [RpcLoadBalancer.Retry](https://rpc-load-balancer.hexdocs.pm/RpcLoadBalancer.Retry.md): Retry logic for RPC operations that may fail when no nodes are available.
